new_identity.memory_query_semantics: SMI physical UUID/rounded memory separate from torch logical cuda:0/properties. Do not demand byte equality between the two interfaces; require one visible logical device mapped via the fixed UUID and record torch capacity.

limitations: Read-only match does not certify present CUDA execution; no preflight repeated
Monitor thresholds retained; no strict dedicated cgroup or PID-ownership claim
Server is not a Git checkout; model/provider source identity uses exact30 SHA256 records
Both arms require the same environment and initial parameter/buffer fingerprints; candidate requires later separate authorization
